notes.title: HANZ PUPPETGUNS | Release
notes.content:
Our little bunny overcame all difficulties. He broke through the zombie wolves and destroyed all the enemies on his way.

HANZ Puppetguns is available for purchase on Steam store from today on the starting price of 0 $. Yes, it's absolutely free!

Hanz is ready to take the brunt and receive a feedback from all sides!

We will be happy if you like Hanz Puppetguns!

Have a good game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/894830/Hanz_Puppetguns/

notes.title: HANZ Puppetguns | Steam Gamepage Launch
notes.content:
Hi guys! Not much time has passed since the release of our previous game BLIK and we're glad to present our new game HANZ Puppetguns!
  
https://store.steampowered.com/app/894830/Hanz_Puppetguns/

  HANZ Puppetguns - is a multiplayer top-down shooter that will make you feel like a real toy hero! At your disposal will be one of four plush rabbits, a variety of weapons and an absolute random and fun!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28672482/5c33c1c55934efd0c6831c3aba4b04ef2759a135.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28672482/86ed2579af2a397e513cef547074ad9b89695ef5.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28672482/90bad777c8dc54d3ad5f0e3c201e3c1a1894348b.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28672482/96323d86d1fbb7682d2eb9133a62049845ed3640.jpg[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28672482/80bc1d627e300e9f016fc5f4e42a3e60b0f7f538.jpg[/img]
